Based on the provided context, I will assume a new patient has been admitted to the ICU with suspected sepsis. To confirm, I need the patient's vital signs and any relevant lab results.

Please provide the following patient data:

- Age
- Vital signs (temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure)
- Lactate level (if available)
- Any relevant lab results (WBC count, CRP, etc.)

Once I have this information, I can provide a specific, evidence-based clinical response with actionable steps.
